summary:
AEROML is an artificial intelligence platform that allows users to locate places on Earth that have similar environments to the Moon and Mars. It solves the problems faced by scientists and space agencies when testing equipment on the surface of alien planets where such actions are costly and complex.

Our platform is based on scientific data from different databases, satellite mission and planetary exploration. It takes into account six environment factors: temperature, terrain elevation, solar illumination, solar radiation, geological composition and water presence.
 These results are presented to the user via interactive websites including planet pictures, maps and comparison charts.

The use case for AEROML is to help astronauts and space agencies in preparing their missions, provide researchers with planetary comparisons and offer an opportunity for students and teachers to study real-life scientific data.

In future, we plan to enlarge our Global Analog Database, add mission simulation for evaluation of possible landing places and create interactive 3D visualization,

In conclusion, our aim will be to make planetary environmental comparisons easier and to facilitate further scientific study and space exploration.
details:
AEROML is a machine-learning-powered platform that identifies locations on Earth matching the environmental conditions of the Moon and Mars. It addresses the high costs and logistical challenges of testing equipment directly on Lunar and Martian surfaces.

Our platform uses scientific data from databases, satellite missions and NASA exploration sources. It focuses on six environmental features: surface temperature, terrain elevation, solar illumination, solar radiation, geological composition and water availability.

Using a custom machine-learning program, we process and compare these datasets through K-Nearest Neighbors terrain matching and environmental scoring. The system ranks potential Earth analogues and displays results through an interactive website featuring planetary views, maps and comparison charts.

AEROML benefits researchers through easier environmental comparisons, supports space agencies in mission preparation, and helps students explore real-world planetary data.

Our approach combines scientific datasets, machine learning and interactive visualizations. We considered environmental differences, data compatibility and measurement consistency when developing the platform.

We used Python for data processing and machine learning, and HTML and Javascript for the website and interactive features.

Future plans include expanding our global database, developing mission simulations and introducing interactive 3D terrain visualization.
